chapter: Building the band: Dave Duncan, Denver and Rene Hall
title: Roy Milton and Roy Walker leave for California
summary: Roy Milton, Roy Walker and drummer Samson Pratt head to California, so Fields needs a vocalist.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: So I took Salva Sanders then in the band. Another band that came in there was the Texas Rangers and a youngster, Pee Wee Wiley was the vocalist there, he had a voice, he could sing. See, Roy then, when this came up, things had got pretty tough around and somebody, I think it was a drummer, Samson Pratt (phonetic spelling), Samson never did drum with me, but he was around at gigs and everything, and somebody contacted Samson-- let's go to California. So Roy said to me, me and Samson are going to California and then Roy Walker, that I was telling you played with Louie, he was in the band, and he said I'm going to try California for a while.

Roy had a car--he had made a little money and had married a girl in Tulsa that had this average job and was doing pretty good and he had a car, and he told the boys that we'll just pay for the gas and we'll go out to California and I believe we'll do better than we're doing now.
Milton, and this Walker and Samson Pratt that wasn't a member of the band.

So when Roy left, I had to hustle a vocalist and so then that's when I got Pee Wee Wiley. It was a coincidence that at that same time the Texas Rangers were in town and so, Salva Sanders had worked with them also and so then he told Wiley, you know I left them and went to the Southern Serenaders, but this Ernie Fields band is a better place than that, you better come on in now because he needs a vocalist. And so I got Pee Wee Wiley.
